sources.publisher: Beyond.pl sp. z o.o.
sources.summary: Beyond.pl reports that it is reviewing the EU AI Gigafactories tender terms and has not decided whether to bid. Regardless of that decision it continues to expand its own AI Factory at its Data Center Campus in Poznań, the first private AI Factory launched in Central and Eastern Europe, powered by the F.I.N. supercomputer, and is steadily increasing the GPU capacity available to customers. It states that the AI Factory operates at Beyond.pl's Data Center Campus in Poznań, which is designed to scale to 100 MW of total capacity. sources.title: HUMAIN and DataVolt Advance AI Infrastructure Framework with Nebius for planned Giga campus in NEOM's Oxagon (DataVolt breaking news, 21 October 2026)
sources.publisher: DataVolt
sources.summary: DataVolt's release, datelined Riyadh, 21 October 2026, announces a preliminary framework agreement between HUMAIN, DataVolt and Nebius for data-centre capacity at the planned AI giga campus in NEOM's Oxagon. Nebius would take up to 50 MW, described as half of the initial 100 MW currently under construction as part of the first phase's planned 360 MW. The release says the framework comes six weeks after construction was announced as having started, and that the allocated capacity is expected to become operational in phases from Q4 2027. DataVolt's CEO says that at Oxagon 'we are building at scale'. The agreement is preliminary and the operating date is a forecast; no part of the campus is said to be complete or operating.
sources.date_semantics: The dateline and page JSON-LD datePublished are 21 October 2026 (14:38 UTC; dateModified 14:55 UTC the same day). The present-tense statement that the initial 100 MW is currently under construction is the operator's own statement as of that day, so 21 October 2026 is used as the observation date. It is not a construction-start date: the release says construction began about six weeks earlier, which matches DataVolt's 31 August groundbreaking release and is already covered by the existing 7 September observation. Q4 2027 is a forecast operating date.

corroborating_copy.note: NEOM's newsroom publishes the same release dated October 21, 2026 (byte offset 128953) with the same 'first 100 MW currently under construction' wording (byte offsets 423 and 129170). It is a second dated source for the publication day and is not used as a separate evidence record.

expected to become operational in phases from Q4 2027
